soundness.checkable_by: Specify the objects, domains, allowed operations, exact conclusion, boundary conditions and faithful interpretation; provide a complete proof or reproducible test. The main claim is not stated precisely enough for Z3. 'Soul-stuff', 'soul-field', 'chi-field', and 'metaphysical processes' are undefined, and the mathematical layer relies on continuum QFT, Noether's theorem, 3-space integrals, and infinite-dimensional unitary evolution. A finite discrete continuity model would only check a simplified side lemma, not the main axiom.
